$Comment: The Horseman's Greaves, one of the four plain pieces of his armour the Horseman's Hoard can pay, the Claim players see as his Boss Kill (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json and its hard twin): the black steel he rode in. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json). Their model is the artist's export of the Horseman's legs and boots made to fit a player (Items/Hallows_Eve/Horseman_Armor/Player/; the Horseman wears his own beside it) in their plain texture, and their icon is drawn from that model by tools/derive_art.py. Their recipe is left out (they are never crafted) and their stats sit a step below the iron greaves', the way the Jack Helm sits below the iron helm, with one thing more: DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 3% harder with them on. Their flaming twin, Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Horseman_Greaves, is the Hoard's stronger copy on the same model, in gold. Light is the ember glow they give off. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent.
